Company Overview IR Library Operating Results IR Calendar Inquiry Who We Are Corporate Philosophy CEO Message Service Overview Company Profile For New Investors Who We Are We leverage technology to solve social issues and provide services to eradicate special fraud (phone scams/wire transfer fraud) , phishing scams, and gray zone crimes (activities that exploit legal loopholes or are ethically questionable despite not being explicitly prohibited by law) . Our “Fraud and Spam Prevention Service” collects and investigates information related to fraudulent calls and SMS messages to build a database that automatically filters such threats. It is deployed on mobile devices, landline phones, and business phones, and is used by approximately 15 million people each month. Corporate Philosophy and Guiding Principles Corporate Philosophy We open the door to a better future for our lives and the world Using technologies for the challenge of solving social issues * Tobila (meaning ‘door’ in Japanese) Systems is dedicated to opening doors to secure communication and a safer digital world. Guiding Principles We are constantly changing without fear of failure and challenging conventional thinking to realize a better future for which we dream. We will be a source of products that help solve social issues and benefit people. We will also pursue appropriate earnings for sustainable steady growth as we expand and upgrade our operations. We believe that maintaining an environment where we can live in peace with our loved ones will directly lead to our growth and a better life for people worldwide. CEO Message Atsushi Akita Representative Director and President Modern society, while benefiting from technological innovation, also faces new threats. The evolution of generative AI raises concerns about its misuse along with expectations for its promise. The development of online communication has created new forms of fraud and crime, causing serious damage not only to the elderly but to society as a whole. It is Tobila Systems’ mission to solve these social challenges by leveraging technology to realize a better world. We believe that creating socially useful products and enhancing our business value will contribute not only to our own growth but also to economic development and the realization of a society where people can live with peace of mind. Our business began with the desire to help my grandfather, who was troubled by bank transfer scams. In 2010, we started developing “TobilaPhone,” a product to filter fraudulent phone calls, and have since been at the forefront of special fraud countermeasures. Our strength lies in our high-quality database of fraudulent phone calls, which has been accumulated over many years. In collaboration with public institutions such as the police, we continuously update and improve the accuracy of our data daily through feedback from approximately 15 million users and independent research. Based on this database, we automatically detect fraudulent phone calls using our unique algorithms that apply statistics and machine learning, providing a safe and secure communication environment for our customers. We strive to create a society where everyone can live with peace of mind and enjoy a convenient and efficient life. By opening the “door,” or “Tobila” in Japanese, we pave the way to a better digital world where safe communication is ensured. Tobila Systems will continue to be the “door that connects our lives and our world to a better future” in order to realize a wonderful world through technology. Service Overview ● Security Business −Provides services to counter special fraud (phone scams/wire transfer fraud) and phishing scams for mobile devices, landline phones, and financial institutions. ·Filtering service for mobile phones Provides the database to each telecommunications carrier and offers services to counter fraudulent phone calls and SMS messages, included in the option packages from the carrier. End users can easily access the services through the carrier’s app. Also provides the advertisement blocking app “280blocker,” which blocks fraudulent phone calls, SMS messages, and advertisements. ·Filtering service for landline phones Offers services in various forms, such as external units, built-in units, and integration into a carrier’s network infrastructure, and blocks nuisance sales calls and fraudulent calls to create a comfortable communication environment. ● Solutions Business −Provides two products for corporations. ·TobilaPhone Biz : A service that enables the use of convenient functions required for office phones by simply adding it to existing phone environments. Service site (Japanese only): https://tobilaphone.com/biz/gw/ ·TobilaPhone Cloud : A fully cloud-based business phone service that migrates existing phone numbers and equipment to the cloud, enabling the use of company phone numbers for incoming and outgoing calls and business phone functions via a smartphone app. Service site (Japanese only): https://tobilaphone.com/biz/cloud/ Company Profile Company name Tobila Systems Inc. Established December 1. 2006 (operations started on April 1. 2004) Share capital 333,780,000 yen (as of October 31. 2025) Listing Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard market (Securities code: 4441) Head office Meiji Yasuda Life Nagoya Building 15F, 1-1 Shinsakaemachi, Naka-ku, Nagoya-shi, Aichi Operation bases Tokyo and Nagoya Directors Atsushi Akita, Representative Director and President Haruo Matsubara, Director and General Manager of Technology Department Norimasa Kanemachi, Director, General Manager of Corporate Planning & President's Office and General Manager of Administration Department Yoji Sugata,Outside Director Hisashi Tanaami, Outside Director and Audit and Supervisory Committee Member Akihiko Kato, Outside Director and Audit and Supervisory Committee Member Kohei Kato, Outside Director and Audit and Supervisory Committee Member No. of employees 134 (including 69 engineers) *As of October 31, 2025 Fiscal year end October Annual general meeting of shareholders Within 3 months from the last day of the fiscal year Record date October 31 of each year Record date for dividends October 31 and April 30 of each year No. of shares per trading unit 100 shares Transfer agent Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited 4-1. Marunouchi 1-chome. Chiyoda-ku.
